instruction: Triage this batch of customer support emails: assign each email to exactly one support category by its primary intent.

emails.subject: Access after role change
emails.body: Since you changed my role I can't see the billing section anymore. Pages load fine for my colleagues, so nothing is down — I just need my permissions put back so I can reach billing.

emails.subject: Still charged for removed seats
emails.body: We removed three seats last month and the app reflects it correctly. The problem is only this invoice: it still bills the old seat count. Please correct the charge.

emails.subject: Export: broken or intended?
emails.body: When we export a large report to CSV it fails every time with an error. Is that expected behaviour, or is it broken? For us it never completes — it just errors out.

emails.subject: Reorg with money and product noise
emails.body: We're splitting into two regional teams. I know that means new invoices for the split, and the new hires will probably want a product walkthrough at some point. But right now what I actually need is operational: move eight users from the EMEA org into a new APAC org and set their manager. It's purely an account-structure change.

emails.subject: Long complaint, real blocker
emails.body: Honestly a bit frustrated. Support was slow last week, the app logged me out twice (I got back in fine), and I still don't fully understand the new line on our bill. But the thing that's blocking us right now: the replacement device you promised for Monday still hasn't arrived — it's Thursday and there's no tracking update. Where is the shipment?

emails.subject: Reads like a bug, is a how-to
emails.body: Our analysts flagged the reporting as 'broken' because the numbers 'don't add up'. I dug in: it's not a defect, the figures are correct. What we actually need is to understand how your rollups define a reporting week and when data is cut off — point us to the docs or explain the behaviour. No fix required.

emails.subject: Praise, wishlist, buried refund
emails.body: Genuinely one of the better tools we use, and your team's been great. Two small things for later: the webhook docs are thin, and it'd be nice if the mobile app remembered my filters. The one thing I need handled now: we were charged twice for the same subscription on the latest invoice and need one of the duplicate charges refunded.

emails.subject: Access request dressed as an outage
emails.body: The project portal 'doesn't work' for our new contractor and it's holding up onboarding. To be precise, the pages load fine for everyone else on the team, so this isn't a service outage — the contractor was just never added. Please grant them viewer permissions on the Atlas project workspace.

provenance.source_benchmark: CRMArena-Pro Case Routing / Activity Priority Understanding (Huang et al., 2025)
provenance.construction_method: Batch-triage task (single input batch -> single labelled output, Section 2.2.3). Difficulty = batch size (3/5/8) x per-email ambiguity; Med/High emails carry competing near-duplicate signals with one primary intent; High emails are verbose with a buried core ask to load the context. Author-constructed from a labelled pool; no benchmark text reproduced.
